taskTitle: Design a differential push-pull source-follower buffer
circuit:
* Differential push-pull source-follower buffer, capacitively bootstrapped.
* Per side: complementary class-AB source followers (LVT N + LVT P, body tied
* to source) whose gates are AC-coupled from the input and DC-biased through
* large resistors from translinear replica stacks referenced to VCM, so the
* quiescent current and output common mode track process corners. Both output
* devices sit under bootstrapped cascodes (native N on top, LVT P below)
* whose gates are AC-coupled from the output, holding each follower's VDS
* near a resistor-programmed constant: this suppresses gds nonlinearity and
* makes nearly all gate capacitance bootstrapped, so the input pins see only
* a small residual load. Long-channel output followers keep gds flat against
* the cascodes' residual VDS ripple.

.subckt buf_ppsf_bs IREF VCM VDD VIN VIP VON VOP VSS

* ===================== bias core =====================
* 20 uA reference in; internal branches run at 10 uA (output ratio 20).
XMN0 IREF IREF VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=10 nf=2
XMN1 pdio IREF VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=5 nf=1
XMP0 pdio pdio VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=24 nf=2
XMP1A nba  pdio VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=24 nf=2
XMP1B nbc  pdio VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=24 nf=2
XMP1D nlref pdio VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=24 nf=2
* LVT sink reference (for the pbc sink, which sits at a low voltage)
XMN0B nlref nlref VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=10 nf=1
* pbb-branch precise sink
XMN2 pbb IREF VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=5 nf=1

* N main-gate reference: nba = VCM + Vgs_N(output density), VDS-matched stack
XMRNC nba nbc xr1 xr1 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_05v0_nvt l=2 w=12 nf=1
XMRN  xr1 nba VCM VCM sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.4 w=6.25 nf=1

* N cascode-gate reference: nbc = VCM + 0.3 + Vgs_native(cascode density)
XMRC2 nbc nbc z1 z1 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_05v0_nvt l=2 w=12 nf=1
RZ1 z1 VCM 30k

* P main-gate reference: pbb = VCM - |Vgs_P|(output density), VDS-matched
XMRP  yr1 pbb VCM VCM sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=20 nf=1
XMRPC pbb pbc yr1 yr1 sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=128 nf=8

* P cascode-gate reference: stiff y2 = VCM - 0.30 (RZ2 carries exactly 20 uA:
* 10 uA MN2C sink + 10 uA diode current taken by the precise LVT sink MN2D),
* then pbc = y2 - |Vgs_Pcasc|(cascode density) -> VDS2 is corner-stable.
RZ2 VCM y2 15k
XMN2C y2 IREF VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=5 nf=1
XMRC2P pbc pbc y2 y2 sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=128 nf=8
XMN2D pbc nlref VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=10 nf=1

* bias decoupling
CDNA nba  VSS 8p
CDNC nbc  VSS 8p
CDPB pbb  VSS 8p
CDPC pbc  VSS 8p
CDM  pdio VDD 5p

* ===================== left half: VIP -> VOP =====================
CA_L  VIP ga_l  100p
RA_L  nba ga_l  120k
CB_L  VIP gb_l  100p
RB_L  pbb gb_l  120k
CCN_L VOP gcn_l 100p
RCN_L nbc gcn_l 120k

XM1_L  dn_l ga_l  VOP  VOP  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.4  w=131.25 nf=10
XM2_L  dp_l gb_l  VOP  VOP  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5  w=420 nf=20
XM2CLA VSS gcp_l dp_l dp_l sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=640 nf=40
XM2CLB VSS gcp_l dp_l dp_l sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=640 nf=40

XM2CLD VSS gcp_l dp_l dp_l sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=640 nf=40

taskTitle: Design a differential push-pull source-follower buffer
circuit:
* Differential push-pull source-follower buffer with bootstrapped cascodes.
* Each output is a complementary class-AB source-follower pair (NMOS pulls up,
* PMOS pulls down, sources joined at the output, bulks tied to sources).
* Gates are capacitor-coupled to the inputs and DC-biased through 100 Mohm
* resistors from VCM-referenced replica branches, so the gate drive can swing
* beyond the rails (bootstrapped class-AB drive) and the inputs draw only a
* small bootstrapped capacitive current. Cascode devices whose gates are
* bootstrapped from the outputs (56/82 pF caps with small series damping
* resistors) hold the main followers' VDS nearly constant, suppressing
* gds-induced gain error and distortion. 100-ohm resistors between the main
* drains and cascode sources damp the ~300-400 MHz bootstrap-loop resonance.
* All bias currents are mirrored from the external 20 uA IREF; replica diodes
* referenced to VCM set the output common mode and the class-AB quiescent
* current (~200 uA per output branch).

.subckt buf_ppsf_bs IREF VCM VDD VIN VIP VON VOP VSS

* ================= bias distribution =================
* External 20 uA flows into IREF; diode sink is the NMOS mirror master.
XMND IREF IREF VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=80 nf=8
* PMOS mirror master (10 uA)
XMN1 pm IREF VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=40 nf=4
XMPD pm pm VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=40 nf=4

* vbn: NMOS-follower gate bias = VCM + VGS(replica)
XMP1 vbn pm VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=40 nf=4
XMRN vbn vbn VCM VCM sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.25 w=6.3 nf=1

* vbp: PMOS-follower gate bias = VCM - VGS(replica)
XMRP vbp vbp VCM VCM sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.18 w=19 nf=2
XMN2 vbp IREF VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=80 nf=8

* vbcn: N-cascode gate bias = VCM + VDSn + VGS(cascode replica)
XMP3 vbcn pm VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=40 nf=4
XMRNC vbcn vbcn ncx ncx sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.7 w=15.5 nf=1
RNX ncx VCM 27k

* vbcp: P-cascode gate bias = VCM - VDSp - VGS(cascode replica)
RPX VCM pcx 27k
XMRPC vbcp vbcp pcx pcx sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=52 nf=2
XMN4 vbcp IREF VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=40 nf=4

* bias decoupling
CDB1 vbn VSS 10p
CDB2 vbp VSS 10p
CDB3 vbcn VSS 10p
CDB4 vbcp VSS 10p

* ================= side A: VIP -> VOP =================
XMNA dma gna VOP VOP sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.25 w=166 nf=19
XMNCA VDD cna dna dna sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.7 w=300 nf=30
XMPA ema gpa VOP VOP sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.18 w=408 nf=40
XMPCA VSS cpa dpa dpa sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=1000 nf=100

CCNA VIP gna 15p
RGNA gna vbn 100meg
CCPA VIP gpa 15p
RGPA gpa vbp 100meg
CBNA VOP kna 56p
RKNa kna cna 15
RCNA cna vbcn 100meg
CBPA VOP kpa 82p
RKPa kpa cpa 15
RCPA cpa vbcp 100meg

* ================= side B: VIN -> VON =================
XMNB dmb gnb VON VON sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.25 w=166 nf=19
XMNCB VDD cnb dnb dnb sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.7 w=300 nf=30
XMPB emb gpb VON VON sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.18 w=408 nf=40
XMPCB VSS cpb dpb dpb sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=1000 nf=100

CCNB VIN gnb 15p
RGNB gnb vbn 100meg
CCPB VIN gpb 15p
RGPB gpb vbp 100meg
CBNB VON knb 56p
RKNb knb cnb 15
RCNB cnb vbcn 100meg
CBPB VON kpb 82p
RKPb kpb cpb 15
RCPB cpb vbcp 100meg

* drain-node damping resistors (main drain to cascode source)
RDNa dma dna 100
RDPa ema dpa 100
RDNb dmb dnb 100
RDPb emb dpb 100
.ends buf_ppsf_bs

taskTitle: Design a differential push-pull source-follower buffer
circuit:
* buf_ppsf_bs : differential push-pull source-follower buffer, bootstrapped (Sky130)
* Two identical class-AB complementary source-follower halves.
* - Output devices are LVT followers with body tied to source (no back-gate effect).
* - Gates are AC-coupled to the input (15p) and DC-biased through 1Meg resistors
*   from replica diodes referenced to VCM -> exact output CM and translinear
*   class-AB quiescent current in every corner.
* - Drains are fully bootstrapped by cascodes whose gates follow the output
*   (5p + 1Meg). Cascode gate DC comes from replica chains (matched diode
*   + I*R shift from VCM), so the follower drains sit at a fixed, corner-
*   independent Vds and the cascodes keep saturation margin at signal peaks.
* - IREF (20uA in) is mirrored to all replica branches; VCM net DC current ~ 0.

.subckt buf_ppsf_bs IREF VCM VDD VIN VIP VON VOP VSS

* ---- bias core ----
* NMOS diode receiving the external 20uA reference
XMD0 IREF IREF VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=8 nf=2
* 10uA mirror to PMOS diode branch
XMND PD   IREF VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=4 nf=1
XMPD PD   PD   VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=16 nf=2
* NMOS replica: BN = VCM + Vgs_n(10uA)   (current pushed into VCM)
XMPB BN   PD   VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=16 nf=2
XMRN BN   BN   VCM VCM sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=5 nf=1
* PMOS replica: BP = VCM - |Vgs_p|(10uA)  (current pulled from VCM)
XMRP BP   BP   VCM VCM sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=17 nf=1
XMNB BP   IREF VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=4 nf=1

* ---- cascode-gate bias replicas (10uA each) ----
* N side: X1 = VCM + 0.18V + Vgs_casc_rep  ->  D1 sits at VCM + 0.18V
XMPX X1   PD   VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=16 nf=2
RX1  X1   X1P  18k
XCRN X1P  X1P  VCM VCM sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.7 w=14 nf=1
* P side: X2 = VCM - 0.22V - |Vgs_casc_rep|  ->  D2 sits at VCM - 0.22V
XCRP X2P  X2P  VCM VCM sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.7 w=25 nf=1
RX2  X2P  X2   22k
XMNX X2   IREF VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=4 nf=1

* ---- two identical buffer halves ----
XHP VIP VOP BN BP X1 X2 VDD VSS buf_ppsf_bs_half
XHN VIN VON BN BP X1 X2 VDD VSS buf_ppsf_bs_half

.ends buf_ppsf_bs

* ---- one push-pull source-follower half ----
.subckt buf_ppsf_bs_half IN OUT BN BP X1 X2 VDD VSS
* input AC coupling and gate bias
CCN IN GN 15p
CCP IN GP 15p
RGN GN BN 1meg
RGP GP BP 1meg
* class-AB complementary followers (body tied to source), Iq ~ 220uA
XMN1 D1 GN OUT OUT sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=110 nf=11
XMP1 D2 GP OUT OUT sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=374 nf=34
* fully bootstrapped drain cascodes, replica-referenced gate DC
XMCN VDD CGN D1 D1 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.7 w=280 nf=14
XMCP VSS CGP D2 D2 sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.7 w=500 nf=25
RCN CGN X1 1meg
RCP CGP X2 1meg
CBN CGN OUT 5p
CBP CGP OUT 5p
.ends buf_ppsf_bs_half

taskTitle: Design a differential push-pull source-follower buffer
circuit:
* Differential push-pull source-follower buffer with drain bootstrapping (Sky130)
*
* Each output is a class-AB push-pull source follower: MN1 (NMOS, pull-up) and
* MP1 (PMOS, pull-down) with their bulks tied to OUT (no body effect).  The
* drains of MN1/MP1 are bootstrapped by the followers MN2/MP2 so that their VDS
* stays constant over the output swing.  All four gates are capacitively coupled
* to the input (the buffer is therefore independent of the input common mode)
* and DC-biased through large resistors from a replica bias column.
* The PMOS stack carries less quiescent current than the NMOS stack; the
* difference is taken by the cascoded NMOS sink MSK/MSKC at OUT.  This lowers
* the low-frequency error of the (weaker) PMOS stack while keeping the class-AB
* pair balanced for high-frequency load current.  The replica midpoint MREP sits
* ~0.11 V above VCM so the PMOS stack also gets more headroom at the trough.

circuit:
* buf_ppsf_bs : differential push-pull source-follower buffer (Sky130)
*
* Each output half is a complementary (push-pull) source follower.  The NMOS
* and PMOS follower gates are driven from the input through coupling
* capacitors and biased from replica-generated class-AB gate voltages.
* Every follower has its bulk tied to its own source (no body effect) and
* every follower drain is fed from a signal-bootstrapped cascode whose gate
* rides on the output node, so the follower drain-source voltage stays
* constant over the whole output swing.  That removes the drain-conductance
* gain error and its distortion, and it bootstraps the follower gate-drain
* capacitance so the input sees almost no capacitive load.
*
* The bias core is a scaled replica of one output branch, closed on itself
* through the cascode so that the follower drain-source voltage is set by a
* Vgs difference plus one resistor offset.  Both terms are threshold
* independent, so the operating point holds over all process corners.

circuit:
* Differential push-pull source-follower buffer.
* Self-biased complementary follower per output.
* Each input directly drives the gate of the top NMOS source follower and the
* gate of an NMOS down-shift source follower.  A PMOS diode stacked under the
* NMOS down-shifter produces a large (~1.2V) corner-adaptive level shift so the
* bottom PMOS follower keeps deep conduction over the full output swing.

.subckt buf_ppsf_bs IREF VCM VDD VIN VIP VON VOP VSS

* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
* Bias reference: 20uA injected at IREF.
* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
XIR IREF IREF VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=5 nf=2

* Down-shift bias sinks at gP_op / gP_on (NMOS mirrors of IREF, ~1.5x).
XDN  gP_op  IREF VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=8 nf=2
XDNN gP_on  IREF VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=8 nf=2

* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
* VOP output leg (follows VIP).
* gN_op = source of the top NMOS follower = VIP (gate driven directly).
* Down-shift:  S_op  = VIP - Vgs(M_dn1);  gP_op = S_op - |Vgs(M_dn2)|.
* Top NMOS follower (gate=VIP) / bottom PMOS follower (gate=gP_op).
* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
XMDO  VDD   VIP   S_op  S_op  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4 nf=2
XMDPO S_op  gP_op gP_op S_op  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=5 nf=2
XNPO  VDD   VIP   VOP   VOP   sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=20 nf=4

taskTitle: Design a differential push-pull source-follower buffer
circuit:
* Differential-input, differential-output push-pull source-follower buffer.
*
* Each output is a single-ended unity-gain feedback buffer whose DC input
* point is set internally so the output common mode is a stable 0.9 V
* regardless of the (0 V, in the SFDR transient) driven input common mode.
* The external input is AC-coupled (ideal 2 pF) to the diff-pair gain node;
* the DC bias there is an ideal resistor to the supplied VCM (0.9 V), so the
* diff pair and loop are biased from VCM alone.
*
* Gain stage: LVT NMOS differential pair with a long-channel PMOS mirrored
* load gives a high-gain error node S1.  A PMOS source-follower level shift
* raises S1 to GN, which drives an LVT NMOS source-follower output (class-A
* with an ideal resistor to VSS for the pull-down).  VOUT is fed back to the
* diff pair.  Weak 5M startup resistors (VDD->GN and VDD->VOUT) guarantee a
* single DC solution from a cold start.
*
* Bias: IREF is sunk by an NMOS diode that sets the NMOS mirror gate bus;
* a PMOS diode branch (fed by an NMOS mirror off IREF) sets the PMOS gate
* bias bus PBX.  All currents are ratios of the supplied 20 uA reference.

.subckt buf_half vinx voutx iref_b pbx vcm vdd vss
* --- input AC-coupling + DC bias to VCM ---
CC x vinx 2p
RB x vcm 12Meg
* --- gain stage: LVT NMOS diff pair + long-L PMOS mirror ---
XMTA tail iref_b vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=50 nf=4
XM1 dm x tail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=80 nf=8
XM2 s1 voutx tail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=80 nf=8
XM3 dm dm vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=80 nf=8
XM4 s1 dm vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=80 nf=8
* --- up-shift: GN = S1 + |Vgs| (LVT PMOS follower, current-source tail) ---
XPLSP SHDRV s1 gn gn sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=20 nf=2
XSHSN SHDRV iref_b vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=15 nf=2
* --- class-A output: LVT NMOS source follower + resistor pull-down ---
RXGN gn vdd 10Meg
XNMP vdd gn voutx voutx sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=320 nf=16
RXO voutx vdd 5Meg
RL voutx vss 20k
.ends buf_half

.subckt buf_ppsf_bs IREF VCM VDD VIN VIP VON VOP VSS
* NMOS diode reference (sinks the 20 uA; gate bus = IREF)
XMREF IREF IREF VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=10 nf=2
* PMOS gate bias branch
XMSB PBX IREF VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=30 nf=2
XMPB PBX PBX VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=30 nf=2
* Half A: VIP -> VOP
XAHA VIP VOP IREF PBX VCM VDD VSS buf_half
* Half B: VIN -> VON
XAHB VIN VON IREF PBX VCM VDD VSS buf_half
.ends buf_ppsf_bs

* Differential-input differential-output buffer (buf_ppsf_bs)
* AC-coupled capacitive feedback + NMOS-input cascoded two-stage amplifier.
*   - Capacitive feedback (C1 in, C2 fb, Rb DC bias to VCM) strips input CM
*     and removes the resistive feedback RC pole that limited bandwidth.
*   - NMOS-lvt input pair + NMOS cascode (kills Miller on input gates) +
*     resistor loads to VDD.
*   - NMOS common-source second stage + PMOS loads, Miller compensated.
*   - continuous-time CMFB pins the output common mode to VCM.

.subckt buf_ppsf_bs IREF VCM VDD VIN VIP VON VOP VSS

* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
* Bias network: IREF -> NMOS diode (NB), mirrored into PMOS diode (PB).
* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
XMNBD IREF IREF VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8     l=0.5 w=2  nf=1
XMNB2 PB   IREF VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8     l=0.5 w=2  nf=1
XMPBD PB   PB   VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=8  nf=2

* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
* AC-coupled capacitive feedback network (gain = C1/C2 = 1).
*   Rb sets the input common mode to VCM (huge -> high-pass below 1 MHz).
* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
C1p VIP INP 90f
C1n VIN INN 90f
C2p VON INP 90f
C2n VOP INN 90f
Rbp INP VCM 10Meg
Rbn INN VCM 10Meg

* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
* Stage 1: NMOS-lvt differential pair + NMOS cascode (gate=PB) +
*          resistor loads to VDD.  Stage-1 outputs o1p/o1n ~0.76 V.
* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
XMT1 tailn IREF VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8     l=0.5 w=16 nf=4
XMI1 n1p  INP tailn VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=40 nf=8
XMI2 n1n  INN tailn VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=40 nf=8
XMC1 o1p  PB  n1p VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=40 nf=8
XMC2 o1n  PB  n1n VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=40 nf=8
R1 o1p VDD 13k
R2 o1n VDD 13k

* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
* Stage 2: NMOS common-source output devices with PMOS loads.
* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
XM6p VOP o1p VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8  l=0.5 w=100 nf=20
XM6n VON o1n VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8  l=0.5 w=100 nf=20
XM7p VOP cfb VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8  l=0.5 w=80  nf=10
XM7n VON cfb VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8  l=0.5 w=80  nf=10

* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
* Miller compensation (Cc + nulling resistor Rz).
* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
CCp o1p czp 0.2p
RZp czp VOP 2k
CCn o1n czn 0.2p
RZn czn VON 2k

* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
* Common-mode feedback: NMOS pair senses (VOP+VON)/2 vs VCM, drives cfb.
*   Resistor loads to VDD make cfb well-defined (no latch).
* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
Rcm1 VOP cms 150k
Rcm2 VON cms 150k
XMCT tailc IREF VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=5  nf=1
XMCa cmb  cms tailc VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4  nf=1
XMCb cfb  VCM tailc VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4  nf=1
Rcfa cfb VDD 60k
Rcfb cmb VDD 60k

* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
* DC-bleed resistors: give VOP/VON a definite DC path so the two-stage
* amplifier cannot latch with both output devices off.
* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
Rblp VOP VSS 1Meg
Rbln VON VSS 1Meg

* Each channel: diode-stack (XDN nfet / XDP pfet) level shifters fed by

* input connects only to source/well nodes of the diode stack, keeping

taskTitle: Design a differential push-pull source-follower buffer
circuit:
* buf_ppsf_bs: differential push-pull buffer.
*
* Each side is a unity-gain feedback loop.  A pFET-input five-transistor
* OTA compares the input against the output and drives the gate of the
* push-pull common-source output stage.  The pFET pull-up gate (GPN)
* and nFET pull-down gate (GNN) are linked by a class-AB translinear
* string: a diode-connected lvt pFET and a diode-connected lvt nFET in
* series, each a ratioed copy of the corresponding output FET, so the
* quiescent through-current is a fixed multiple of the IREF-derived
* string bias current and tracks process by matching.  Miller
* compensation with a nulling resistor closes each loop.
*
* Bias: the 20 uA IREF pin feeds a diode NFET (MREF); a self-biased
* p-diode branch (MPB/MNB) creates the p-mirror gate PB.
* Side n: VIN -> VON ; side p: VIP -> VOP.

.subckt buf_ppsf_bs IREF VCM VDD VIN VIP VON VOP VSS
* ---------------- global bias ----------------
MREF IREF IREF VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1
MPB  PB   PB   VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=15 nf=4
MNB  PB   IREF VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1
* ================= side n: VIN -> VON =================
* OTA p-input pair (lvt): feedback VON on diode side, input VIN on output side
MPTN  TPN  PB   VDD  VDD  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=15 nf=4
MFBN  DNN  VON  TPN  TPN  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=7.5 nf=2
MINN  GPN  VIN  TPN  TPN  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=7.5 nf=2
MN1N  DNN  DNN  VSS  VSS  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4 nf=1
MN2N  GPN  DNN  VSS  VSS  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4 nf=1
* OTA output pull-up
MPCSN GPN  PB   VDD  VDD  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=22 nf=4
* class-AB translinear gate string between GPN (p gate) and GNN (n gate)
MPDSN ANN  ANN  GPN  GPN  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=12 nf=3
MNDSN ANN  ANN  GNN  GNN  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=6 nf=2
MNCSN GNN  IREF VSS  VSS  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1
* push-pull common-source output
MUPN  VON  GPN  VDD  VDD  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=32 nf=5
MDNN  VON  GNN  VSS  VSS  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=18 nf=3
* Miller compensation with nulling resistor

CCN   GZN  VON  0.12p
* ================= side p: VIP -> VOP =================

MFBP  DNP  VOP  TPP  TPP  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=7.5 nf=2
MINP  GPP  VIP  TPP  TPP  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=7.5 nf=2
MN1P  DNP  DNP  VSS  VSS  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4 nf=1
MN2P  GPP  DNP  VSS  VSS  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4 nf=1

taskTitle: Design a differential push-pull source-follower buffer
circuit:
* Differential push-pull source-follower buffer, Sky130.
*
* Per half (local subckt ppsf_half):
*   XPLS PMOS source follower shifts VX UP  -> gate GN of pull-up XNOUT.
*   XNLS NMOS source follower shifts VX DOWN -> gate GP of pull-down XPOUT.
*   XNOUT (NMOS, VDD -> VY) and XPOUT (PMOS, VY -> VSS) are the class-AB
*   push-pull output followers; bulks tie to their own source (no body effect).
*   The shifter supply legs are cascoded mirrors, so their conductance at the
*   bias point is tiny and the shifted gates follow VX with ~unity gain.
* IREF (20 uA) develops the NMOS and PMOS mirror gates plus the two cascode
* bias gates.  A VCM-referenced continuous-time CMFB loop sets the output
* sink-mirror gate NGIL so that (VON+VOP)/2 = VCM.

.subckt ppsf_half VDD PG0 VBP VBN NGIL VX VY VSS
* Cascoded pull-up leg (PMOS mirror of PG0, cascode gate VBP).
XIUM N1 PG0 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1 nf=1
XIUC GN VBP N1 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1 nf=1
* Cascoded pull-down leg (mirror gate NGIL, cascode gate VBN).
XILM N2 NGIL VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1 nf=1
XILC GP VBN N2 VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1 nf=1
* Follower level shifters.
XPLS VSS VX GN GN sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=1 nf=1
XNLS VDD VX GP GP sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
* Push-pull output followers.
XNOUT VDD GN VY VY sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.75 w=12 nf=1
XPOUT VSS GP VY VY sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.7 w=22 nf=1
.ends ppsf_half

.subckt buf_ppsf_bs IREF VCM VDD VIN VIP VON VOP VSS
* --- Bias references from the 20 uA IREF port ---
XNREF IREF IREF VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=4 nf=1
* 1:1 leg developing the PMOS mirror gate PG0.
XMNPG PG0 IREF VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=4 nf=1
XMPREF PG0 PG0 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=8 nf=1
*
* --- Cascode gate generation ---
* NMOS cascode gate VBN: 10 uA PMOS leg feeding two diode NMOS in series.
XPNB NBT PG0 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1
XDN1 NBT NBT NB2 VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4 nf=1
XDN2 NB2 NB2 VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4 nf=1
* PMOS cascode gate VBP: two diode PMOS stacked into a 10 uA NMOS sink.
XNPB PB2 IREF VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1
XDP2 PB2 PB2 PB1 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4 nf=1
XDP1 PB1 PB1 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4 nf=1
*
* --- Output common-mode feedback to VCM ---
RFP VOP CMA 500k
RFN VON CMA 500k
XCMT CMX IREF VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=1 nf=1
XCMN NGIL VCM CMX VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=2 nf=1
XCMP PCM CMA CMX VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=2 nf=1
XCMPLD PCM PCM VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4 nf=1
XCMPLG NGIL PCM VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4 nf=1
CCFB NGIL VSS 1p
*
* --- Two identical differential halves ---
XHP VDD PG0 PB2 NBT NGIL VIP VOP VSS ppsf_half
XHN VDD PG0 PB2 NBT NGIL VIN VON VSS ppsf_half
.ends buf_ppsf_bs

*     PB-mirrored PMOS sources; output quiescent current tracks the shifter

*              du (up-shifter drain), dd (down-shifter drain)

XMPU  du  VIN ng  ng   sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=10 nf=2

taskTitle: Design a differential push-pull source-follower buffer
circuit:
* Differential buffer (buf_ppsf_bs).
* Architecture: NMOS source follower + NMOS gm-boost sink per half.
*   - Each half: an NMOS follower (drain at VDD, bulk=source) sources the
*     quiescent current into the output; an NMOS "boost" device (drain at the
*     output, source/bulk at VSS) sinks it. The follower sets the output, the
*     sink adds flat feedforward gm driven by the OPPOSITE input through a
*     small capacitive divider (k ~ 0.02), which cancels the w*CL gain droop
*     up to 40 MHz without loading the output node.
*   - Follower gate is AC-coupled from its own input (lossless DC level shift
*     onto the replica bias point) and is bootstrapped, so input capacitance
*     is only the ~30 fF boost coupling cap.
*   - Quiescent current comes from replica diodes at matched current density,
*     referenced to VCM / VSS, so it tracks process corners.
*   - The two halves are identical, so even-order distortion cancels in the
*     differential output.

.subckt buf_ppsf_bs IREF VCM VDD VIN VIP VON VOP VSS
* --- bias: IREF (20 uA in) is sunk by the NMOS mirror diode ---------------
XMR0  iref iref VSS  VSS  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.98 w=20   nf=4
* NMOS mirror sink (matched density) pulls the PMOS reference diode
XMN1  pd   iref VSS  VSS  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.98 w=5.75 nf=2
XMPD  pd   pd   VDD  VDD  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1    w=40   nf=4
* PMOS mirror outputs feed the two replica diodes
XMP1  nrf  pd   VDD  VDD  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1    w=40   nf=4
XMP2  nrc  pd   VDD  VDD  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1    w=40   nf=4
* replicas: same l and current density as the follower / boost devices
XMRF  nrf  nrf  VCM  VCM  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.98 w=2.5  nf=1
XMRC  nrc  nrc  VSS  VSS  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.98 w=2.5  nf=1
* --- two identical half circuits ------------------------------------------
XHP   VIP VIN VOP VDD VSS nrf nrc sfhalf
XHN   VIN VIP VON VDD VSS nrf nrc sfhalf
.ends buf_ppsf_bs

* NMOS source follower (bulk tied to source: no body effect)
XFOL  VDD  gn  OUT OUT sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.98 w=100 nf=20
* NMOS boost sink: gate driven by the opposite-phase input
XCSN  OUT  gc  VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.98 w=100 nf=20
* signal coupling and gate bias feeds

RG1   gn   NRF 10meg

RG2   gc   NRC 10meg
CSH   gc   VSS 1.1p

taskTitle: Design a differential push-pull source-follower buffer
circuit:
* Differential push-pull source-follower buffer (Sky130 1.8V LVT devices).
*
* Each half-circuit is a complementary (push-pull) source follower:
* NMOS follower (sourcing) stacked with PMOS follower (sinking), one
* quiescent current providing both transconductances; bulks tied to
* sources (no body-effect gain loss).  Each follower drain is fed from a
* current mirror (high impedance) and is AC-bootstrapped to its own
* output through Cd, so the follower vds is nearly signal-free: the gds
* gain error and the gds nonlinearity that would limit SFDR are both
* strongly suppressed.  N/P betas are ratioed for equal overdrive so the
* push-pull currents cancel even-order terms.  Gates are DC biased at
* replica-generated levels (VBN/VBP) and the input is AC-coupled onto
* them.
*
* Bias: IREF (20 uA in) terminates in diode XMN0.  Mirrors form a 20 uA
* branch through stacked diodes XMNBR (1/11 of the NMOS follower, source
* at VCM) and XMPBR (1/11 of the PMOS follower), giving
* VBN = VCM + Vgs_n(20u), VBP = VCM - Vsg_p(20u).  The follower
* quiescent current is ratio-pinned at ~220 uA in every process corner
* and the output common mode sits at VCM.

.subckt buf_ppsf_bs IREF VCM VDD VIN VIP VON VOP VSS

.subckt buf_ppsf_bs IREF VCM VDD VIN VIP VON VOP VSS
* Differential-input, differential-output push-pull source-follower buffer.

XPDI  VBP  VBP  VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=8 nf=1

* --- Channels ---
XCHP IREF VBP VDD VIP VOP VSS buf_ppsf_ch
XCHN IREF VBP VDD VIN VON VSS buf_ppsf_ch
.ends buf_ppsf_bs

.subckt buf_ppsf_ch IREF VBP VDD VIN VOUT VSS
* Stage 1: PMOS pair (wide CM), NMOS mirror.  XFB gate=VIN (mirror side), XINP gate=VFB.
XINP n1 VFB  nS VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=10 nf=1
XFB  n2 VIN  nS VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=10 nf=1
XTL  nS VBP  VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=8 nf=1
XN1  n1 n1   VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4 nf=1
XN2  n2 n1   VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4 nf=1

XCSL n3 VBP  VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=8 nf=1

* Miller compensation (keep loop crossover << SF pole).
CMILL n3 n2  0.3p

* PMOS LVT source follower output: Vout = n3 + |Vgs|.

XPCS VOUT VBP VDD  VDD  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=20 nf=1

circuit:

* .subckt buf_ppsf_bs IREF VCM VDD VIN VIP VON VOP VSS

RBN VDD vbn 10k
CBN vbn VSS 20p

CCDN vbncs VSS 20p
RCS1 VDD vbicsp 200k

taskTitle: Design a differential push-pull source-follower buffer
circuit:
* buf_ppsf_bs: differential push-pull buffer, Sky130.
* Two-stage fully-differential amplifier with internal unity-gain feedback:
* VOP feeds back to the VIN-side pair, VON to the VIP-side pair. The
* cross-coupling provides differential feedback and CM feedback; at DC the
* mirror-loaded input pairs force each output to its input DC level.
* Stage 2 per output: complementary push-pull pair whose BOTH gates tie
* straight to the stage-1 output node (quasi-inverter drive). Device
* widths are chosen so the quadratic terms of the two devices cancel
* (push-pull linearity); quiescent current self-balances where the two
* device currents cross. No level shift needed -> no extra bias current.
* Input pairs are source-degenerated for large-signal linearity.
* All bias currents mirror the IREF pin (20 uA).

.subckt buf_ppsf_bs IREF VCM VDD VIN VIP VON VOP VSS

* ---------- Bias master ----------
XM0   IREF IREF VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=10 nf=2

* ---------- Channel P: error amp driving VOP ----------
* Pair: + input VIP, - input VON (feedback). Source degeneration 2k.
XM1P  s1p  VIP  tp1 VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.25 w=25 nf=5
XM2P  diP  VOP  tp2 VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.25 w=25 nf=5
RDP1  tp1  tp   2k
RDP2  tp2  tp   2k
XMT1  tp   IREF VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=40 nf=8
RSTP  tp   VSS  10k
* PMOS mirror load.
XPL1P diP  diP  VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=9 nf=2
XPL2P s1p  diP  VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=9 nf=2
* Weak bleeds: kill the zero-current latched state at startup; matched on
* both mirror nodes so the DC balance (vop = 0.9 V) is preserved.
XBLP1 s1p  IREF VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=3 nf=1
XBLP2 diP  IREF VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=3 nf=1
* Push-pull output stage, both gates on s1p.
XMOP  VOP  s1p  VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=10 nf=2
XMON  VOP  s1p  VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=16 nf=4

circuit:
* buf_ppsf_bs: differential push-pull buffer in SKY130 (V4).
*
* Per side (VOP follows VIP, VON follows VIN):
*   MPD  - lvt PMOS source follower sinking class-A (drain vss,
*          bulk=source=output -> no body effect). Gate driven from the
*          input through a coupling capacitor; a small same-flavor
*          PMOS diode ("battery", bulk=input) to the input sets the DC
*          offset so Vsg tracks Vth over corner.
*   MPU  - long-channel (l=8) PMOS common-source pull-up. Its gate pu
*          is driven by the OPPOSITE side's battery node through a
*          series capacitor (derivative drive): the sourcing current
*          arrives in phase with d(vout)/dt so the follower error stays
*          tiny. A fraction of MPU (diode-connected, same gate/source

*   Servo- slow per-side loop (diff pair vout-vs-vin -> inverter ->
*          RSE/CSE -> pu gate) forces DC gain to 1 and output CM to
*          input CM; it also absorbs the MPD/MPU current mismatch.
